ModMetaData.name: Visceral Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Horrors (mlie.horrors)'s Visceral art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Cauldron sheet 2026-10-04, owner pick B for the adult; his picks C/D for VisceralBaby/VisceralTeen are copies of the donor pictures, owned here so no donor art is kept). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Visceral/Visceral_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
